title: Quick Grilled Brazilian Nectarine Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Brazilian dish featuring nectarines, perfect for warm weather, this paleo-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor. The combination of mustard and nectarine creates a delightful springy taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together paleo mustard, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Thread the nectarine chunks onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the marinade onto both sides of the nectarine chunks.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the nectarines are slightly caramelized.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle the lime juice over the skewers and serve immediately.
Let the skewers cool for a minute or two before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
